meta.name: coding-agent-sessions
meta.description: Finds, reads, and reconstructs coding-agent sessions across Codex, Claude, OpenCode, OMO/Senpi, and other local agent logs. Use when asked to find or search past sessions, transcripts, or subagent runs, or to recover what an earlier session did.

counter.description: 静态文本估算: CJK 字符 + 拉丁词 + 符号混合计数;不代表任一模型真实 tokenizer。单文本文件 >256KB 或 symlink 逃逸包外的不计入。

copy.tagline: 把散落在本机的编程助手会话记录找出来,还原上一次到底做了什么
copy.fit_line: 适合你,如果同时用好几个编程助手,想找回之前某次会话干了什么
copy.tagline_en: Dig up past coding-agent sessions and reconstruct what an earlier run did
copy.fit_line_en: For you if you juggle several coding agents and need to recall what a past session did

howto.what: 装上后，Claude 会先在你本地的编码 agent 日志里找历史会话，而不是凭记忆回答。它跨 Codex、Claude、OpenCode、OMO/Senpi 等平台搜索，找到后读取并还原那次会话做了什么，可用子会话拼出完整委派树。
howto.when: 当你要求查找或搜索过去的会话、transcript、subagent 运行，或想还原更早某次会话做了什么时触发，也包括「前几天我在忙什么」这类回忆式提问。

say.text: 帮我找一下几天前那个 OpenCode 的 bug 会话
say.note: 会跨平台搜索并列出候选会话

say.text: 搜索提到 deploy 的会话，只看 Codex 平台
say.note: 按平台和关键词过滤结果

say.text: 读一下那个会话，顺便看它派生的子会话
say.note: 打开主会话会带出全部子会话

howto.what_en: After installing, Claude searches your local coding-agent logs before answering from memory. It finds past sessions across Codex, Claude, OpenCode, OMO/Senpi and others, then reads the chosen session to recover what it did; child sessions can rebuild the delegation tree.
howto.when_en: Use when you ask to find or search past sessions, transcripts, or subagent runs, or to recover what an earlier session did, including vague recall like "what did I work on a few days ago".

say_en.text: Find that OpenCode bug session from a few days ago
say_en.note: Runs a cross-platform search and lists candidates

say_en.text: Search sessions mentioning deploy, Codex platform only
say_en.note: Filters results by platform and keyword

say_en.text: Read that session and show its subagent runs
say_en.note: Opening a main session returns its child sessions
